report.title: Social Environmental Impact Assessment Report: Bosigon Irrigation Project, Labo, Paracale & Vinzons, Camarines Norte
report.accessLimit: The official PDF direct fetch returned 403 in this review. Search-indexed PDF extracts exposed the fish survey narrative and Table 2-10 (report page 85), but the full methods and bibliography were not independently inspected.

evidenceAssessment.fieldCatch: The report extract says no fish were captured during the sampling period and attributes this to inclement weather.
evidenceAssessment.interviews: Residents interviewed near the rivers reported common names Banak, Palos, Tilapia, Dalag and Hipon; the extract does not provide interview dates, respondent counts, exact river locations or a vernacular-to-species verification method.
evidenceAssessment.otherClaims: The report says a River halfbeak (Zenarchopterus sp.) was sighted in the river area in an unspecified study and cites online articles from Soltes (2011) and the Municipal Government of Labo (2019). It gives no bibliographic crosswalk to specimens or to the table's Zenarchopterus kampeni row.
evidenceAssessment.tableProvenance: Table 2-10 is titled Freshwater Biota from the Study Area and lists scientific names, families, IUCN status and endemicity. No per-row source, survey event, date, station, coordinates, gear, specimen, voucher or data citation is shown in the extracted text. The table therefore conflicts with the no-fish-captured account unless rows are compiled from secondary sources or interviews; their provenance is unresolved.
evidenceAssessment.occurrenceDecision: Do not treat any table row as a direct fish occurrence in Labo or Bosigon River. Do not treat the no-capture result as absence.

verificationFlags.name: Crenimugil seheli
verificationFlags.issue: The report table calls it Endemic without stating the geographic scale. Eschmeyer's Catalog records an Indo-West Pacific distribution and lists accepted generic combinations including Moolgarda seheli; the table's locality-endemic interpretation is not supportable from the report excerpt.
verificationFlags.decision: Preserve only as a verbatim table claim; do not adopt the endemicity label or normalize the name in a public record.

verificationFlags.name: Ophiocephalus striatus
verificationFlags.issue: Eschmeyer's Catalog treats the name as a synonym of Channa striata. The report's Introduced label is retained as a source claim but is not resolved or adopted here.
verificationFlags.decision: Do not silently normalize or assign native/introduced status without a dated authority and evidence specific to the project rivers.

verificationFlags.name: Hemigrapsus sanguineus
verificationFlags.issue: This is a crab, not a fish; the World Register of Marine Species classifies its environment as marine and does not support treating it as a freshwater fish record.
verificationFlags.decision: Exclude from freshwater fish checklist and keep it as an unverified report-table invertebrate claim.

verificationFlags.name: Tilapia mossambica; T. nilotica
verificationFlags.issue: The table reports two names under one vernacular row and gives no specimen or observation crosswalk.
verificationFlags.decision: Do not split into occurrence records or map them to current accepted names for the rivers.

nextAction: Seek a dated, specimen-backed fish survey for Labo and Bosigon rivers from the LGUs, NIA or BFAR; retain interview reports, EIS compilations and scientific field records as separate evidence classes.

sources.supports: Officially hosted EIS search extracts: fisheries narrative, no fish captured during sampling, interview common names, and Table 2-10. Direct fetch was blocked, so not all report claims were independently inspected.
